_comment: Known WCAG2A/AA violations as of the day this gate was introduced, captured live with `npx playwright test a11y.spec.ts` against a production build. This is a regression gate, not a pass/fail bar: CI fails only if a route grows a NEW rule ID or an EXISTING rule's node count increases. It does not fail on this pre-existing debt. Fixing these is an app-level design/contrast decision (see Engineering Playbook, Decision Register) — out of scope for the pipeline itself.
_updated_2026-08-11_rebuild: Re-scanned all 4 routes live against current origin/main (post-rebuild). color-contrast counts dropped substantially (main's independent work improved contrast broadly, not this branch's doing — verified live, not assumed). aria-hidden-focus reappeared on /about, /report, /location/:id (not /) — traced to CommandCenter.jsx's overlay (focusable close button while aria-hidden, present on every route that has opened it at least once) — this is main's own component, already tracked as KNOWN_ISSUES.md #14 (needs a real focus-trap across 3 overlays, judged too large for a scope-locked commit, not a quick patch) — baselined here, not silently patched. button-name (6 nodes, TerminalTooltip.jsx icon-only buttons with no aria-label) was fixed for real, not baselined — see that file's diff.
_fixed_2026-08-29: aria-hidden-focus removed from all 4 routes below, fixed for real, not baselined away. Root cause traced precisely: CommandCenter.jsx's overlay stays mounted and toggles aria-hidden, which does not by itself remove keyboard focusability from descendants. `inert` is the WHATWG-recommended pairing, but this app is on React 18, which does not support `inert` as a JSX prop (confirmed live: passing inert={!open} rendered no DOM attribute at all). Fixed by setting `container.inert` imperatively in the shared useFocusTrap.js hook (already used by CommandCenter/NavMenu/QuickCapture/UnitFinder), gated on the same `open` state the hook already tracks. Verified live: 0 aria-hidden-focus nodes on all 5 scanned routes post-fix, all 11 focus-trap/account-menu/a11y e2e tests passing.
